title: Sacred Geometry Method & Invariants Atlas
purpose: Separate exact geometry, construction history, art/architectural use, documented esoteric interpretation and Potatoverse symbolism so mathematical truth is never used as automatic proof of historical or spiritual claims.

five_layers.asks: What construction, coordinates, lengths, angles, areas, symmetries or topological properties are exact?
Where and when is this form materially/textually attested?
What meaning did a documented tradition/source actually assign to it?
Which structural similarities recur across sources while differences remain explicit?
How does Potatoverse use the form, and when did that mapping appear?

vesica_exact_model.construction: Two congruent circles of radius r whose centers are separated by r.

invariants.quantity: central angle subtending overlap in each circle

vesica_exact_model.consequence: These relations follow from Euclidean geometry whether or not any symbolic interpretation is attached.

shape_distinctions.rule: Vesica Piscis is an exact two-circle geometric construction; mandorla is an almond/oval sacred-art enclosure that may resemble or be constructed from vesica geometry but is an art-historical category.
2D circle properties cannot be transferred automatically to 3D sphere cosmology.
A 2D polygon and 3D solid have different symmetry/topology; symbolic relation must state which object is meant.
A 10-sided plane polygon and a 12-faced Platonic solid are different objects; decagonal sections can arise in dodecahedral/icosahedral geometry without making them identical.
Logarithmic, Archimedean, Fermat and other spirals have distinct equations; visual spiral resemblance does not identify the family.

historical_claim_contract.warning: Later occult or modern popular interpretations must not be projected backward into ancient or medieval objects without evidence.

comparative_tests: Is the geometry exact, approximate, decorative or retrospectively fitted?
Does the historical source name the symbolic meaning being claimed?
Could the same geometry arise from ordinary construction constraints rather than esoteric intent?
Are modern diagrams standardizing a tradition that historically had multiple forms?
Is a numerical coincidence being selected after seeing the result?
Does the comparison survive scale, rotation and coordinate choices?
Is a mathematical invariant being confused with a causal physical mechanism?

project_geometry_record.rule: Project symbolism may be exact internally even when no historical tradition shares the same mapping.

high_value_research_routes: architectural geometry with measured plans rather than speculative overlays
Platonic solids and documented ancient philosophical uses
historical Kabbalistic/Hermetic diagrams in source-specific forms
Islamic geometric art as mathematical/architectural tradition without collapsing it into Western occultism
South Asian yantra/mandala traditions in their own textual/ritual contexts
modern esoteric reinterpretations as dated reception history
anti_patterns: golden ratio claimed from visual resemblance without measurement
all sacred buildings treated as one hidden geometric code
modern esoteric diagram backdated into antiquity
mathematical elegance used as proof of supernatural causation
one culture's symbol translated into another culture's doctrine merely because shapes resemble
project geometry stated as inherited historical teaching without source evidence
